fusions.name: Drizzle Lob
fusions.desc: Lobs a drop that deals 5 damage with a 40% chance of [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cloudburst
fusions.desc: The sky opens, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a splash of 80% of that to enemies within 3.5 tiles of each.

fusions.name: Falling Grey
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Steady Downpour
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
